drills.title: Counter-Attack Drills (3v2, 4v3)
drills.note: Practice quick ball recovery and immediate vertical passes to exploit defensive disorganization.

drills.title: Finishing from Fast Breaks
drills.note: Refine decision-making and accuracy in front of goal after rapid transitions.

days.why_stat: Red was involved in a counter-attack or fast vertical transition in 7 minutes, highlighting this as their primary offensive outlet.

drills.title: Possession Rondo with Progression Gates
drills.note: Develop controlled possession with a focus on breaking lines and advancing the ball into attacking zones.

drills.title: Attacking Third Overload Play
drills.note: Work on creating numerical advantages and intelligent movement in the opponent's final third.

days.why_stat: Red's engagement in the attacking third was severely limited, registering only 3.2 minutes of fractional time in attack, indicating a need to improve sustained offensive pressure.

drills.title: Gegenpress Scenarios (Small-Sided Games)
drills.note: Train immediate high-intensity pressing upon losing possession to win the ball back quickly in advanced areas.

drills.title: Defensive Block & Mid-Block Transition
drills.note: Practice shifting from a deep defensive line to a more aggressive mid-block when appropriate opportunities arise.

drills.title: Recovery Session
drills.note: Focus on light activity and regeneration after high number of recovery events in the last match.

days.why_stat: Red dropped its defensive line deep in 15 minutes, while also using gegenpress in 12 of 29 minutes, indicating a need to integrate these defensive actions more effectively.

drills.title: Wide Play & Crossing Drills
drills.note: Focus on fullbacks making overlapping runs to provide width and deliver quality crosses into the box.

drills.title: Attacking Combinations with Fullbacks
drills.note: Integrate fullbacks into attacking sequences with wingers and central midfielders to create varied threats.

days.why_stat: Red's fullbacks played defensive in 15 minutes and overlapping in 14, suggesting an opportunity to increase their attacking contribution.

drills.title: Light Tactical Walkthrough
drills.note: Review opponent's tendencies and Red's tactical plan for the upcoming match, focusing on key movements.

drills.title: Set Piece Practice (Offensive & Defensive)
drills.note: Refine routines for corners, free kicks, and defensive positioning during opponent's set pieces.
